Chili Seasoning Mix

  • 3/4 C Chili Powder (I use mild)
  • 2 TBSP Cumin
  • 2 TBSP Oregano
  • 2 TBSP Dried Minced Onion
  • 2 TBSP Seasoned Salt (See Seasoned Salt Recipe)
  • 2 TBSP Sugar
  • 2 tsp Dried Minced Garlic or 1 tsp Garlic Powder

It depends on how much Chili you make but I usually add 1 TBSP of the mix and just add more from there. I usually end up with no more than 2 1/2 TBSP of the mix for a 1 LB. Ground Beef/Chicken or Diced Chicken.

However, if I use crushed or diced tomatoes with green chili peppers then I will not use 2 1/2 TBSP of the Chili mix.
